en.title: 26 of 114 resorts in Poland have snow on top: the list
en.description: 26 of 114 resorts in Poland have snow on top: the list. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Poland on 18 November.
en.lede: 26 of the 114 resorts in Poland have snow on their upper slopes today. Karpacz leads with 46 cm.

p: Snow on the upper slopes is not the same as open runs: lifts open when the base is deep enough to groom, and the resort decides that.
590 km² of snow-covered ground in Poland this Wednesday, down 580 km² on yesterday. In other words, 5 % of the mapped high ground is white.
At the top of the list, Karpacz reports 46 cm.
Next on the list: Kasprowy Wierch (28 cm), Szrenica (17 cm), COS Szczyrk (13 cm) and Dwie Doliny Muszyna-Wierchomla (12 cm).
At Karpacz: 7 cm of fresh snow over three days, 12 cm more expected by Saturday 21 November.
At Kasprowy Wierch: 13 cm of fresh snow over three days, 16 cm more expected by Saturday 21 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 26 out of 114 resorts in Poland.

The rest of the shortlist: Szrenica: 17 cm on top, 6 cm in three days, 10 cm expected; COS Szczyrk: 13 cm on top, 2 cm in three days, 4 cm expected; Dwie Doliny Muszyna-Wierchomla: 12 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 1 cm expected.

sections.h: How deep it is, height by height
p: Height makes the difference: between 500 and 1,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 2 % covered; between 1,000 and 1,500 m, 2 cm on average, 37 % covered; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, 19 cm on average, 100 % covered.
Over the next three days up to 10 cm is expected, and up to 13 cm over the week.
Thursday 19 November stands out, with up to 5 cm in a day.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 22 cm on the snowiest slopes.
Snow cover in Poland over the last days: 16 November 1,170 km²; 17 November 1,170 km²; 18 November 590 km².
The deepest resort changed hands 1 times this week.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.
Mild days have cost 530 km² since the 1,120 km² of a week ago. The snow line sits near 1,200 m.

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: Three-day totals peak at 6 cm, around the Tatras, the Karkonosze and the Beskids.
About 150 km² received at least 5 cm.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Slovakia: 10 % white, deepest Ski centrum Dedinky with 42 cm, up to 15 cm in the week ahead; Czechia: 0 % white, deepest Figura Praděd with 15 cm, up to 10 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 1,500 m the ground is almost fully white (100 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 1,000 m and 1,500 m the cover is patchy, about 37 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,000 m the slopes are still almost bare.
If you can choose the day, go after Thursday 19 November: the fresh snow then has time to settle and the roads to be cleared.

advice: Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Morning snow is firm after a clear night: wait for the sun on south faces.
Snow above the tree line can be wind-packed: watch the ridges.

pl.title: Warunki śniegowe w Polsce, 18 listopada 2026: ośrodki, świeży śnieg i najbliższe dni
pl.description: Śnieg w Polsce 18 listopada: pokrywa śnieżna, świeży śnieg, grubość według wysokości, najbliższe dni i najlepsze ośrodki.
pl.lede: W Polsce pod śniegiem jest dziś około 590 km² (środa, 18 listopada). To o 580 km² mniej niż wczoraj. To 5 % obszaru górskiego w Polsce, który obserwujemy.

p: Tydzień temu było 1 120 km²: od tego czasu stopniało 530 km². Granica śniegu przebiega na około 1 200 m.
Grubość śniegu zależy od wysokości: 500–1 000 m: średnio poniżej 1 cm (2 % pod śniegiem); 1 000–1 500 m: średnio 2 cm (37 % pod śniegiem); 1 500–2 000 m: średnio 19 cm (100 % pod śniegiem).
Sumy z trzech dni sięgają 6 cm. Najwięcej: Tatry, Karkonosze i Beskidy.
Odwilż zjada pokrywę: rano twardy śnieg, po południu mokry.
Tydzień może przynieść do 13 cm, z czego do 10 cm w najbliższe trzy dni.
Najbardziej śnieżny dzień: czwartek, 19 listopada, do 5 cm.
Dalej, w dniach 8–14, na najbardziej śnieżnych stokach może przybyć do 22 cm.
Prowadzi Karpacz: 46 cm w górnej części tras.
Ośrodki ze śniegiem na górnych trasach: 26 z 114.
Dalej: Kasprowy Wierch (28 cm), Szrenica (17 cm), COS Szczyrk (13 cm) i Dwie Doliny Muszyna-Wierchomla (12 cm).
Kasprowy Wierch: 13 cm świeżego śniegu w trzy dni i jeszcze do 16 cm do dnia sobota, 21 listopada.

advice: Powyżej granicy lasu śnieg bywa nawiany przez wiatr: uważaj na graniach.
